<div class="review-text">
Surprised by the exceptional quality. The game has a great feel and atmosphere to it right off the batI'm a bit overwhelmed by the incredible amount of *stuff* to do, but I don't think that's such a bad problem to have, all things considered, for a game that's pretty sandbox-esque. I feel like my main joy came from just walking around pretty randomly generated worlds, and I didn't care much for the RPG or sandbox stuff, though.
